explication: Antikythera is an Elixir framework for running multiple web-service “gears” on one ErlangVM cluster. A request is routed by domain to a gear, whose code handles HTTP or WebSocket work; gears can also communicate locally and enqueue distributed jobs. The platform manages tenant resource pools and gear deployment, while providing configuration, logging, alerting, and metrics. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with sampled implementation paths; several subsystem links are documented capabilities rather than inspected call sites.
